archetypes.name: scope-gate-reviewer
archetypes.rationale: The change alters a workflow gate that decides whether /implement pauses for operator input.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the nonblocking todo classifier is narrow enough to avoid hiding real deferred work. Check that Step 2 dispatch, scope-disposition validation, and manifest prompt docs stay consistent. Cite exact file paths, symbols, and tests for each finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
